resources.string: Your computer can use this tablet as a display
Check that the computer shows the same code: %1$s
Pair only if the computer shows this same code, and confirm there too:
Your computer\'s desktop opens here by itself when you start it from the computer, over Wi-Fi or the USB cable.
The computer\'s desktop opens on its own.
For the computer\'s desktop to open on its own, allow Screenlet to display over other apps. Without it, open Screenlet first.
On your computer: Screenlet → Pair a tablet.
To use it again, you will compare a code once more.
Tap to go back to it
Also after a restart: the computer can use the tablet at any time. It only listens; it uses next to no battery.
Off: your computer reaches this tablet only for 10 minutes after you open Screenlet.
On your computer, open Screenlet, click Pair a tablet and choose “%1$s”.
So the pairing code and the computer\'s desktop appear by themselves, and the computer finds this tablet even with no Wi-Fi network, allow notifications, nearby devices and “Display over other apps”.
